sourceNote: Printed page 207: the blanks (viii)–(xx) of question 8 of the exercise of Chapter 11, followed by a row of three stars. The page is cropped at the left edge in the scan, so the last words of most lines are cut off and have been restored from the sense (e.g. the subject at the start of each item); the exact printed wording of items (xii)–(xx) needs checking against a complete scan. The honorifics printed after the names are omitted in this transcription. The blanks are left empty. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n-1 (file = {p//2+1:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2+1:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
